_meta.description: AntennaMaster hardware catalog. Entries with 'equipment_class' come from curated source records (app/data/catalog_sources/) carrying per-record 'provenance' and 'spec_confidence' (datasheet | published_typical | class_reference). Values marked class_reference are engineering-standard planning figures for the family, NOT vendor datasheet guarantees — confirm the exact SKU before design. Extend by dropping a JSON into catalog_sources or AM_DATA_DIR and re-running tools/ingest_catalog.py.
